State Of Tennessee Treasury Department increased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 67.95% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. State Of Tennessee Treasury Department bought 2.06 million shares as the company’s stock declined 7.66% with the market. The institutional investor held 5.09M shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $171.09M, up from 3.03 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. State Of Tennessee Treasury Department who had been investing in At&T Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $204.88 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.25% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $28.15. About 58.57 million shares traded or 43.99% up from the average. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 17.31% since December 28, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.31% the S&P500.
State Of Tennessee Treasury Department, which manages about $20.59B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Twenty (NASDAQ:FOXA) by 434,978 shares to 424,659 shares, valued at $19.67 million in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Mattel Inc (NASDAQ:MAT) by 295,759 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 76,824 shares, and cut its stake in Activision Blizzard Ince (NASDAQ:ATVI).
